summary: Full Tempo EN/KO guide+quiz audit complete; current3.0.3 architecture/configuration/TraceQL/correlation/IAM corrections with bounded native evidence and explicit distributed-security/runtime limits.
findings: Fully read all four original documents (EN795, KO1004, quizzes185 each;2169 lines). Preserved all65 original rendered heading IDs, including Korean numeric-section anchors. Updated actual content metadata through recognized Last Updated/마지막 업데이트 headers.

Pinned Tempo3.0.3 and maintained community tempo-distributed3.6.0/app3.0.3 using official releases/checksums. Chart Kubernetes constraint is explicitly not an EKS compatibility/test matrix; no blind latest-version compatibility assertion.

Replaced obsolete Tempo2 ingester/compactor setup with Tempo3 Kafka microservices and a separate no-Kafka monolithic loopback example. Explained Kafka durability/ISR/retention, live-store/block-builder emptyDir, backend scheduler/workers, vParquet4+ side-by-side2→3 migration and unsupported downgrade.

Confirmed exact Tempo3.0.3 common Kafka client options expose SASL/PLAIN without Kafka TLS/SCRAM/MSK-IAM configuration. Distributed values are explicitly render-only until broker transport/authentication, all advertised addresses, topic partitions, ownership and recovery are verified. No fabricated secure MSK recipe or cloud deployment claim.

Rendered24 base and27 generator resources. Explicit ServiceAccount monitoring:tempo, role annotation, OTLP service ports4317/4318, query frontend3200, S3 HTTPS, tenant ingestion limits and correct max_recv_msg_size_mib. No guessed legacy chart keys, internal-ALB-as-auth or anti-affinity-as-PDB claims.

Enabled span-metrics/service-graphs through tenant processors as well as generator Deployment; mounted existing remote-write TLS certificate Secret and scoped destination prerequisites. Documented ephemeral WAL and unverified replay/destination behavior.

Replaced undefined KMS resource/old IAM module/duplicate CLI ownership with complete provider6.64 S3+IRSA Terraform. Bucket Block Public Access/owner-enforced/SSE-S3/TLS deny, exact OIDC aud/sub and bucket/account-scoped role grants; deletion protection and optional KMS key-policy requirements. No blanket S3 object expiry conflicting with Tempo retention; versioning/noncurrent costs explained.

Actual Tempo3.0.3 TraceQL Compile checked30 queries:3 original syntax errors reproduced;14 current queries valid. trace:id and nestedSetParent are valid in this release, not incorrectly removed; nestedSetParent is not nesting depth. Corrected count/avg/rate syntax, invalid traceSpanCount, right-side child/descendant semantics, time-range and HTTP/DB semantic-convention distinctions.

Local Tempo3.0.3 synthetic one-span test passed ready, OTLP POST, TraceID lookup, service/error TraceQL search and spans counter. Initial immediate search was empty; later older timestamps/polling returned data. Scope is one loopback process/local storage, not Kafka/S3/HA or causal isolation of search delay.

Corrected Grafana tracesToLogsV2 Trace→Logs versus Loki derivedFields Logs→Trace (including quiz7). Current macro escaping, exact data-source UIDs/service-label mapping, whitespace-safe32hex log regex, no span filter without IDs, exemplar label mapping and span-metrics status labels are explicit.

Error-ratio PromQL now fills missing numerator from total and divides only by positive total. Actual promtool3.14 cases pass healthy0/all-errors1/mixed0.2/zero-trafficempty/absentempty. No false healthy result from missing telemetry.

Python trace logging now checks valid SpanContext rather than is_recording, keeps unsampled nonrecording IDs, UTC/message formatting/exceptions and avoids propagation duplicates;8 actual OTel1.44 assertions. Java points to previously reviewed scoped-MDC helper with explicit source/API-only validation limitation.

Removed destructive/obsolete forced-flush diagnostics and credential-environment dumps; do not assume Tempo image contains shell/AWSCLI. Distinguish readiness, valid OTLP ingestion, query lag and full distributed health. Dashboard uses actual spans counter, process RSS and HTTP search histogram/route rather than byte counter-as-memory or invented metric.

Personally viewed2 old architecture PNGs; replaced their source references with4 native Mermaid11.16 parsed/rendered/personally viewed write/read flows. Old HTML/PNG and foreign translations remain untouched for parent ownership.
